parent.engineering: Focused, G29 and inherited full dual-platform PASS
parent.science: WSP71 negative: 507/768 confident correct versus 394 matched B repeat; 371/435 retained; 347/366 true synthetic labels; 11 confidently wrong on 128 quartic negative cases > frozen 6. Preserve unchanged.

hypothesis: Can agreement between two independently constructed source-blind neural teachers, plus contradictions from already physically charged B observations, select safer synthetic memories for direct numerical weight consolidation than a matched-count random selection from the same teacher's proposals, without surrendering retention or unfamiliar-world confident safety?

cohort.physics: Four each parity, three-input AND, mixed coupled/negated, plus four independently seeded four-input XOR quartic challenges; deliberately overlapping earlier source families, NOT independent real-world transfer
cohort.train: ONE physically continuous 192-action source-hidden no-reset public trajectory from zero state per world. 96 consecutive A, 96 B. Same charged sequence and public consequences for all arms. Source private role labels never used in learner.
cohort.eval: 768 full primary physical state/action audits, 384 two-step tasks, 256 quartic negatives; source evaluator labels withheld until AFTER model training.

teacher: Stage A train exact unmodified WSP70 ReusableInteractionNeural residual feature-selector and an independently seeded 'random' interaction-selector on the SAME 96 charged A rows, both growth at 48/96. Two numerical snapshots, no source imports, no backprop.
dreams: Primary teacher proposes up to 32 confident full four-bit next-state predictions across 64 publicly enumerable states/actions; prior A-unseen context priority as WSP71. Independent random-feature teacher must ALSO confidently agree exactly and if Phase B includes this state/action, its physically charged label must not contradict the proposed label. Accept at most k=min(32, gated proposal count, unique actually charged A inputs). B contradiction gate uses ONLY already physically charged B data, NEVER oracle test labels. If no agreement, k=0 and count negative.
candidate: Use frozen primary learned ReLU hidden-weight bank; reset numerical output weights and inverse ridge covariance, directly edit real output weights with exactly 96 common Phase-B physical observations then k accepted pseudo memories. Ridge lambda=0.5, same margin 0.27 and leverage 2.0; no gradients, rule compiler, source imports or observation lookups during inference. Cold snapshot numeric only.
matched_comparator: Use same primary teacher bank, identical B rows, exactly k pseudo labels randomly chosen by fresh fixed SHA seeded selection from the SAME original primary proposal pool, without using independent teacher agreement or B contradictions. Both arms pay equivalent 2-teacher+proposal computation accounting, and EXACT same number of extra weight edits. Difference is selection information, NOT equal information quality.
additional_controls: 96 B plus k stored actually observed physical A facts, stronger raw memory baseline
96 B plus k duplicated physical B rows, matched update count but less Phase A knowledge
96 B plus k action-scrambled gated dreams, adversarial negative
Original WSP71 ungated up-to-32 teacher dreams, unequal k diagnostic ONLY

Full trainable 8→32→4 Adam MLP with three independent 6000-step maximal seeded restarts trained on same B rows; >=95% training exact required for qualified converged baseline, but B-only MLP receives less Phase A information

primary.classification: SELFTEST_SIGNAL iff ALL conditions, else SELFTEST_NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE

secondary: Report per-world source/task/charged A+B ledger/dream proposal/accepted SHA256 receipts, teacher numerical snapshot, selected k, disagreement and B physical contradictions, cold replay and tamper.

Absolute correct, wrong confident, abstain, never physically charged true prediction, Stage A retention, two-action compositions, quartic negative false confidence, pseudo label accuracy audited evaluator-only.
End-to-end gradient neural convergence and CPU, all equal-k controls, whole teacher+replay+inference cost. K equal does not mean equal information quality.
Committee teachers share physical evidence and source-aligned structural grammar; they can share confident wrong predictions. No reliability guarantee.
limits: Same small four-bit synthetic source families; no general intelligence, language, open-world transfer or scientific independent confirmation.

Candidate only rewrites numerical readout weights; fast teacher hidden representations are preprogrammed action-conditioned conjunctions and preserved. This is weight programming, not unconstrained neural feature discovery.
Hypothetical teacher predictions are NOT fresh physics observations and cannot be counted as charged real actions.
Failure preserves exact frozen thresholds; no postresult confidence recalibration or source tweaks.
qualification: Frozen before source, learner, tests, outcomes. Focused Ubuntu+Windows + generated-only source-pinned G29 + inherited full dual-OS regression on exact candidate. No duplicate run; no SCIENTIFIC_PASS inferred from SELFTEST.
